datasetMetadata.datasetName: Gridded GEDI Vegetation Structure Metrics and Biomass Density at Multiple Resolutions
datasetMetadata.nasaSource: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / LP DAAC / PO.DAAC
datasetMetadata.instrument: Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) High-Resolution Laser Altimeter on the ISS

visualizationReference.entry: GEDI Global Canopy Height & Aboveground Biomass Map

rh100.description: Canopy Height (100th relative height percentile of returned waveform)

canopyCover.description: Canopy Cover (fractional ground surface covered by canopy vertical projection)

pai.description: Plant Area Index (total one-sided leaf and stem area per unit ground surface area)

fhd.description: Foliage Height Diversity (vertical Shannon entropy index of canopy profile distribution)

agbd.description: Aboveground Biomass Density (metric tons dry organic matter per hectare)

ndvi.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (MODIS canopy greenness index)

observationPeriod.note: Historical satellite laser altimetry reanalysis and composite gridded metrics. Not a live telemetry link.

scientificTransparency.dataIntegrity: Authentic NASA GEDI Level 4B & Level 3 gridded calibration observations
scientificTransparency.sonificationMethod: Deterministic parametric mapping of physical canopy structure into musical pitch, harmonic resonance, arpeggio complexity, and sub-bass resonance
scientificTransparency.fieldRecordingAttribution: Natural environmental acoustic layers (wind, leaves, birds, water, insects) are procedurally modeled and synthesized inspired by National Park Service Natural Sounds archival surveys.
